'''Living Fog''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}. It summons {{M|Gas Bomb|Gas Bombs|2}} that explode for damage and then die.

== Living Fog ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Living Fog
|Image  = StS2_Living Fog.png
|HP     = 80
|AscHP  = 82
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Normal
}} 
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Smoggy
|Image        = StS2 Icon Smoggy.png
|Description  = You can only play 1 Skill per turn.
|Type         = Debuff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
|Cap          = 
}}
=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Living Fog}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Advanced Gas
|Intent = Attack2, CardDebuff
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage. Applies 1 {{BD2|Smoggy}}.
|GivesToPlayer = Smoggy
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Bloat
|Intent = Attack2, Summon
|Effect = Deals (5;{{Asc2|9|6}}) damage. Summons 1 {{M|Gas Bomb|Gas Bomb|2}}.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Super Gas Blast
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always uses {{Int2|Living Fog|Advanced Gas}} first, then alternates between {{Int2|Living Fog|Bloat}} and {{Int2|Living Fog|Super Gas Blast}}.

{{Clear}}

== Gas Bomb ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Gas Bomb
|Link   = Slay the Spire 2:Living Fog#Gas Bomb
|Image  = StS2_Gas Bomb.png
|HP     = 7
|AscHP  = 8
|Powers = {{BD2|Minion}}
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Minion
}} {{Power Infobox|Minion|2}}
Gas Bombs are minions summoned by Living Fog via {{Int2|Living Fog|Bloat}}.

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Gas Bomb}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Explode
|Intent = DeathBlow
|Effect = Deals (8;{{Asc2|9|9}}) damage. Dies.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Uses {{Int2|Gas Bomb|Explode}} every turn, dealing damage and killing itself.
{{Clear}}
